certification.name: GIAC Experienced Incident Handler
certification.description: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering incident handling, attacker exploits, reconnaissance and analysis of attacks, infrastructure and vulnerabilities. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.
certification.currency_note: Applied Knowledge exam; $499 for holders of the corresponding active base Practitioner certification (GCIH is the audience named on the page)
